title: Very Much of Create

body:
⚙️ Very Much of Create

The ultimate Create modpack experience — but way more.

“Very Much of Create” is a large-scale modpack built around the Create ecosystem, pushing automation, engineering, and creativity to the next level. With nearly 200 mods , this pack transforms Minecraft into a fully industrial sandbox where you can design massive factories, complex logistics networks, and advanced machinery.

🏭 Core Features
🔩 Heavy Create Expansion

This pack includes a huge collection of Create add-ons, massively expanding what you can do:

Advanced machinery & automation
Trains, transport systems & logistics
Energy generation and industrial production
New mechanics, recipes, and engineering tools

Examples include:

Create: Aeronautics (airships & flying machines)
Create: Big Cannons
Create: New Age, Factory, Generators, Optical, and many more
🌍 World & Exploration
New biomes with Biomes O’ Plenty
Enhanced villages and world features
More immersive environments and structures
🍔 Food & Farming
Expanded cooking systems with Farmer’s Delight
Create-integrated food production
Automation for farming and processing
🏠 Building & Decoration
Tons of decorative blocks and styles
Create-based building systems
Interior and design-focused mods
🚀 Transport & Movement
Fully working trains and rail systems
Vehicles and aircraft (Immersive Aircraft)
Advanced item transport systems
⚡ Performance & QoL

Optimized for large factories and long playthroughs:

Performance mods like FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, EntityCulling
UI improvements (JEI, Jade, Better Advancements)
Stability tools and compatibility fixes
🎯 What This Pack Is About

This is not a lightweight pack — it’s designed for:

Big factories 🏭
Automation lovers ⚙️
Creative engineering 🧠
Long-term survival worlds 🌍

If you enjoy building complex systems and watching machines come to life, this pack is for you.

⚠️ Requirements
A decent PC is recommended (large modpack)
NeoForge loader (included in modpack)
6–10 GB RAM recommended
💡 Final Note

“Very Much of Create” is all about going bigger, smarter, and more complex with Create.
If normal Create feels too small — this is your upgrade.
